privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect through the aiva.hr website, the purposes for which we process it, the legal basis for doing so, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and what rights you have. It is aligned with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the General Data Protection Regulation, or GDPR) and the Croatian Act on the Implementation of the General Data Protection Regulation.
privacy.s1Body: The controller of your personal data, meaning the entity that determines the purposes and means of processing, is:
privacy.s1Dpo: We have not appointed a data protection officer, as this is not mandatory under Article 37 GDPR given our activities and the scale of our processing. For any data protection matter, please write to the email address above.
privacy.s2Body: We collect only the data we genuinely need for a specific purpose. It falls into the following categories:

s2Groups.name: Contact form data
s2Groups.desc: You provide this voluntarily when you send us an enquiry through the form:
items: the content of the message you send us

s2Groups.name: Intro call booking data
s2Groups.desc: Appointments are booked through Calendly, which opens on its own website. The data you enter there (name, email address, chosen time slot and any note) is collected by Calendly and passed to us so we can arrange and hold the meeting.

s2Groups.name: AI assistant conversation data
s2Groups.desc: A chat widget is available on the site. If you use it, the content of the messages you type and technical data about the chat session are processed. Please do not enter sensitive personal data or confidential business information into the chat.

s2Groups.name: Technical data and server logs
s2Groups.desc: Collected automatically on every visit to the site:
items: browser and operating system type and version
date and time of access and the pages viewed

s2Groups.name: Display preferences
s2Groups.desc: Your choice of dark or light mode is stored in your browser's local storage. It stays on your device and is not transmitted to us or to any third party.

privacy.s2Ip: Please note that your IP address is also used to rate-limit form submissions as protection against abuse, and appears in the internal notification email we receive when an enquiry comes in.
privacy.s3Title: 3. Purposes of processing and legal basis
privacy.s3Body: Every processing operation rests on a clearly identified legal basis under Article 6 GDPR:

s3Rows.purpose: Responding to enquiries sent through the contact form
s3Rows.detail: Our legitimate interest is to reply to someone who has contacted us of their own accord. If the enquiry moves towards an engagement, the basis shifts to steps taken at the data subject's request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).

s3Rows.purpose: Arranging and holding an intro call
s3Rows.detail: Processing is necessary so that we can arrange a time at your request and prepare for the conversation.

s3Rows.purpose: Delivering our services and performing client contracts
s3Rows.detail: Processing of client contact persons' data in order to carry out the agreed engagement.

s3Rows.purpose: Operating the AI chat assistant on the site
s3Rows.detail: You start the widget by your own action when you open a conversation. If you do not use it, no conversation content is processed.
Rate limiting, spam protection and server logging so that incidents can be detected.

s3Rows.purpose: Measuring traffic and improving the site
s3Rows.detail: Analytics runs only where enabled. The solution we use works without cookies and does not track individual visitors.
Obligations arising from accounting, tax and other applicable legislation.

privacy.s4Title: 4. How long we keep your data
privacy.s4Body: We keep data only for as long as it is needed for the purpose it was collected for, or for as long as the law requires:

s4Rows.what: Contact form enquiries that do not lead to an engagement

s4Rows.period: For the duration of the engagement, and thereafter for the periods prescribed by accounting and tax legislation
In line with the provider's settings and retention periods, as a rule up to 12 months
Up to 12 months after the appointment is held or cancelled

privacy.s4After: Once these periods expire, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymised. You may request deletion earlier, except where we are required to retain the data to meet a legal obligation or for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
privacy.s5Body: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data to third parties for their own purposes. We share it only with service providers who process it on our behalf and on our instructions (processors), with whom we have data processing agreements in place under Article 28 GDPR:

s5List.name: Chatbase
s5List.role: AI chat assistant on the site

s5List.name: Sanity AS
s5List.role: Content management system for the site

privacy.s5Fonts: Typefaces are served from our own server, because fonts are bundled into the application at build time. As a result, visiting the site sends no requests to Google's servers and your IP address is never disclosed to Google.
privacy.s5Authorities: We may also disclose data to competent authorities where we are required to do so by applicable law, or where it is necessary to protect our legal interests.
privacy.s6Title: 6. Transfers outside the European Economic Area
privacy.s6Body: Some of the processors listed above are based in the United States. In those cases the transfer relies on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses under Article 46 GDPR and/or on the recipient's participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework under the European Commission's adequacy decision pursuant to Article 45 GDPR, together with supplementary technical and organisational safeguards.
privacy.s6Copy: You may request a copy of the safeguards we rely on at our data protection address.
privacy.s7Body: In relation to your personal data, you have the following rights:

s7List.name: Right of access
s7List.desc: To obtain confirmation as to whether we process your personal data, and to be given access to that data and a copy of it.

s7List.name: Right to rectification
s7List.desc: To have inaccurate data corrected and incomplete data completed.

s7List.name: Right to erasure
s7List.desc: To have your data deleted where it is no longer necessary for the purpose it was collected for, or where you withdraw your consent.

s7List.name: Right to restriction of processing
s7List.desc: To have processing temporarily suspended, for example while the accuracy of the data is verified or your objection is resolved.

s7List.name: Right to data portability
s7List.desc: To receive the data you provided to us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, and to transmit it to another controller.

s7List.name: Right to object
s7List.desc: To object to processing based on our legitimate interest, in which case we will stop processing unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds to continue.

s7List.name: Right to withdraw consent
s7List.desc: To withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

s7List.name: Right to lodge a complaint
s7List.desc: To lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority for personal data protection.

privacy.s7How: You can exercise any of these rights by writing to our data protection address. We will respond without undue delay and at the latest within one month of receiving your request. That period may be extended in justified cases, and we will tell you if it is. To protect your data we may ask you to confirm your identity. Exercising your rights is free of charge.
privacy.s8Body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. We use them as sparingly as possible, in the following categories:

s8Groups.name: Strictly necessary cookies
s8Groups.desc: Required for the basic operation and security of the site. They are set without consent because the site cannot function properly without them.

s8Groups.name: Consent management cookies
s8Groups.desc: Record your choice in the consent banner so that you are not asked again on every visit.

s8Groups.name: Analytics cookies
s8Groups.desc: Set only with your consent. The analytics solution we use operates without cookies and does not track individual visitors or build profiles of them.

s8Groups.name: Chat assistant cookies
s8Groups.desc: The chat widget may set cookies or use local storage in order to maintain the continuity of your conversation.

privacy.s8Manage: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time through the consent banner on the site. You can also delete all cookies yourself and block them in advance in your browser settings. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may affect how the site works.
privacy.s8Storage: Your display mode preference is saved in your browser's local storage rather than in a cookie, and remains solely on your device.
privacy.s9Body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures: all traffic to the site is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS, access to data is limited to those who need it to do their job, the contact form is protected by rate limiting and a spam detection mechanism, and credentials and keys are held in a protected environment separate from the source code.
privacy.s9Caveat: No security measure can guarantee absolute safety when data is transmitted over the internet, but we review and improve our measures regularly. In the event of a personal data breach likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you and the supervisory authority within the periods prescribed by the GDPR.
privacy.s10Body: We do not carry out automated decision-making that produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR. The AI assistant available on the site provides informational answers only and does not make decisions about you.
privacy.s11Body: Our services are intended for business users and are not directed at people under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect children's personal data. If you believe a child has provided us with their personal data, please contact us and we will remove it without delay.
privacy.s12Body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology or applicable law. The date of the last revision is shown at the top of this page. We will notify you of material changes by appropriate means, and we recommend reviewing the policy periodically.
privacy.s13Body: For any question about this policy, about how we process your personal data, or to exercise your rights, please contact us at:
privacy.s13Azop: If you believe that our processing of your personal data infringes data protection law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority:
privacy.s14Body1: By accessing this website you agree to use it lawfully and in good faith. You may not use the site to transmit harmful, unlawful or offensive content, to collect data without authorisation, or in any manner that jeopardises its operation, availability or security. We reserve the right to restrict or deny access to the site at our discretion.
privacy.s14Body2: All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, photographs and source code, is the property of Modelity d.o.o. or its licensors and is protected by copyright and intellectual property law. Reproduction, distribution, communication to the public or modification of the content without our prior written consent is not permitted.
privacy.s14Body3: The content of the site is published for information purposes and constitutes neither a binding offer nor professional advice. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we accept no liability for damage arising from the use of, or inability to use, the site. All relations arising from use of the site are governed by the law of the Republic of Croatia, and the competent court in Koprivnica shall have jurisdiction over any disputes.

voiceAgent.title: AI receptionist
voiceAgent.description: A voice AI agent that answers incoming calls, handles questions and books appointments straight into your team's calendar.

voiceAgent.title: AI receptionist: from a phone enquiry to a booked appointment
voiceAgent.intro1: While your team is with a client, out on a job, or done for the day, the phone can still ring. An AI receptionist can take the call, answer questions and help the caller arrange a next step, from leaving a message to booking an appointment.
voiceAgent.s2Title: What does a single call look like?
voiceAgent.s2Intro: Picture a car service centre that a client calls to arrange an appointment. This is an example conversation with an agent connected to the workshop's calendar.

s2Turns.text: Good afternoon, I'm the car service centre's AI assistant. How can I help you?
I'd need an appointment for a minor service.
Which vehicle is the service for?
A Golf, 2020. Thursday after three would suit me.
The agent checks the calendar and the rules for how long the service takes. If a suitable slot is free, it can offer it.
Thursday at 15:30 is free. Does that work for you?

voiceAgent.s2After1: Once the caller agrees, it collects a name and contact details and confirms the exact date, time and service. Only after the system confirms the booking went through does the agent say the appointment is reserved. Your team sees the booking in the calendar they already use day to day. If confirmations are connected, the client can also receive an SMS or email with the details.
voiceAgent.s2After2: If the requested slot is not available, the agent offers an alternative. If the booking fails, it says clearly that the appointment is not confirmed and offers to record the request for your team.
voiceAgent.s3Body3: That is why an AI receptionist is built around three things: the information it is allowed to use, the actions it can carry out, and the rules by which it leads the conversation.

s3Pillars.name: Information
s3Pillars.desc: The company content the agent is allowed to draw on when answering.

s3Pillars.name: Actions
s3Pillars.desc: The concrete tasks it may carry out through connected tools.

s3Pillars.name: Rules
s3Pillars.desc: How it leads the conversation, and when it hands over to your team.

voiceAgent.s4Title: What can it take on during a call?

s4Items.name: Answers to common questions
s4Items.desc: Opening hours, location, services, how to prepare for a visit, and any prices you have approved for giving out over the phone.

s4Items.name: Booking appointments
s4Items.desc: Checking availability and reserving a slot. Changes and cancellations can be added if the chosen system and integration support them.

s4Items.name: Recording enquiries and contacts
s4Items.desc: Name, contact details and a summary of the request, so your team has what it needs to pick the conversation up.

s4Items.name: Connecting to a member of staff
s4Items.desc: Routing the call to the right person or department according to rules agreed in advance and what your telephony allows.

voiceAgent.s5Title: How does it connect to your tools?
voiceAgent.s5Body1: An AI receptionist reaches data through approved integrations. That lets it check current availability or status and carry out a specific action during the call.
voiceAgent.s5Body2: Google Calendar, for example, can be used to check what is booked and to write in an appointment. A CRM can store a new enquiry and contact, and a messaging system can deliver the booking confirmation.
voiceAgent.s5Body3: For every project we check what the existing software allows. The working details matter too: how long each service takes, opening hours, breaks, which staff are available and at which locations. A free slot in the calendar is only worth offering once it also fits those rules.
voiceAgent.s6Title: When does the AI answer the phone?
voiceAgent.s6Intro: How it answers is adapted to your organisation and to what your phone system allows.

s6Items.name: At the start of every call
s6Items.desc: The AI takes the enquiry and handles the agreed tasks, routing onward any call that needs a member of staff.

s6Items.name: When nobody can pick up
s6Items.desc: The phone rings for your team first. After an agreed interval the call is forwarded to the AI receptionist.

s6Items.name: Outside working hours
s6Items.desc: The AI can answer basic questions, capture a request or book a permitted appointment while the company is closed.

voiceAgent.s7Title: When does your team take the call over?
voiceAgent.s7Body1: A request to speak to a member of staff, a complex enquiry, a complaint, or the absence of reliable information are all reasons to bring in a person.
voiceAgent.s7Body2: Who such a call goes to, and what happens if that person is unavailable, is decided in advance. One option is to take a message and contact details for a call back, without promising a response time your team has not confirmed.
voiceAgent.s7Body3: The agent introduces itself as an AI assistant at the start. Its instructions and checks are set up so that it does not give out unapproved prices, does not invent free appointments, and does not declare a task done before the system confirms it.
s7Guardrails: Introduces itself as an AI assistant at the start of the call.
Does not give out prices you have not approved for the phone.
Does not declare a task done before the system confirms it.
voiceAgent.s8Title: How do we approach a solution like this at Aiva?

s8Steps.name: First we get to know your calls
s8Steps.desc: What do people ask most often? What details do you need for a booking? Which conversations should always be taken by a member of staff? The answers define the scope of the AI receptionist.

s8Steps.name: Then we connect the information and the tools
s8Steps.desc: We prepare the company content, the conversation rules and the integrations needed. We also agree on data access and on how summaries or recordings are retained, where these are used.

s8Steps.name: Before go-live we test real situations
s8Steps.desc: Changing an appointment mid-conversation, a name that is hard to make out, the caller interrupting the agent, a full calendar and an unavailable system. We also test what the agent does when it cannot resolve a request.

s8Steps.name: After go-live we watch what happens
s8Steps.desc: How many enquiries were resolved, appointments booked and calls handed to the team? Where do callers get stuck? That data drives the adjustments that follow.

s9Items.q: What actually is a voice AI agent?
a: A voice AI agent is a system that holds a conversation with a caller and can carry out tasks through connected tools. An AI receptionist is one application of it, built to handle incoming phone calls.
The person calling says what they need in their own words, and the agent leads the conversation according to your company's rules and information.

It can explain a service, check availability, collect details or connect the call to a member of staff. Its scope is defined up front: which information it uses, what it is allowed to do, and when it needs to bring in your team.

s9Items.q: What happens behind the scenes during a call?
a: During the conversation the system processes speech and works out what the caller is asking for. It answers using the information you have given it, and to check or write data it reaches into a connected business tool. It then delivers the result by voice, in the same conversation.

A question about opening hours only needs up-to-date company information. A booking needs access to a calendar or scheduling system. Checking an order status needs a connection to the system that holds that data.

s9Items.q: Do we have to change our existing phone number?
a: Depending on your operator and phone system, the connection can be made through call forwarding or your existing exchange. Before choosing a solution we check how you can carry on using your own number.

s9Items.q: Can it speak Croatian and other languages?
a: It can, given a technology that supports the languages you need. We test comprehension, the pronunciation of names and how natural the conversation feels using examples from your own business.

s9Items.q: What if we already have a scheduling system?
a: We first check whether it supports a connection and which actions it allows. If writing to it directly is not possible, the agent can capture the request for your team to confirm afterwards.

s9Items.q: Who benefits most from a receptionist like this?
a: Companies where appointments are often arranged by phone, where callers ask for the same information, or where enquiries come in while the team is busy. Car service centres, salons, accommodation providers and service trades are typical examples. Whether it fits depends on your actual calls and how the company works.
If most calls need expert judgement, a more useful role for the AI receptionist may be to collect the basic details and pass the enquiry to the right member of staff.

voiceAgent.ctaTitle: How would an AI receptionist work for you?
voiceAgent.ctaBody: Tell us what kind of calls you get, when they are hardest to answer, and which tools you use. Together we can work out what an AI receptionist could take on and how it would work alongside your team.
